newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker with foreign markets.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker with foreign markets.

text.p: 1706 GMT - Portuguese shares ended weaker in line with foreign markets, but above session lows, accompanying the drop in international markets. The upward revision of U.S. GDP, concerns over French elections on Sunday and the row between the Bundesbank and the Bonn government over the valuation of official reserves, weighed on international markets. Shares of cork group Corticeira Amorim rose more than seven percent after encouraging first quarter results, dealers said. Dealers said the trend on Monday would depend largely on the results of the elections in France.
